# Chapter 1: Time-Series Momentum and Volatility Scaling [pages 1-18]
When 20-day realized volatility declines below its 60-day median while 20-day return is positive, risk-adjusted forward 10-day returns in liquid Taiwan large-cap equities improve significantly.

# Chapter 2: Fundamental Revenue Acceleration Signals [pages 19-42]
Monthly revenue year-over-year growth standardized over a 12-month trailing window provides an orthogonal fundamental signal with a 10-day reporting lag.
